name: bnbUSD
oneLiner: bnbUSD is Sigma Money's BNB and slisBNB-backed dollar on BSC, minted through an f(x) V2-style PoolManager with Stability Pool liquidations.
collateral: Overcollateralized WBNB (0xbb4cdb9cbd36b01bd1cbaebf2de08d9173bc095c) and Lista slisBNB wrapped as SY-clisBNB (0x8b98563d66b74e5a644bff78fc72c86bba847a29) held by PoolManager (0x0a43ca87954ed1799b7b072f6e9d51d88cca600e) across two SigmaLongPool markets on BSC. Small residual allocations sit in YieldStrategy contracts (0.1 WBNB and 0.1 SY-clisBNB) and WBNB short-pool lending (4.60 WBNB); Sigma's earlier Lista DAO idle-asset yield strategy is marked sunset in protocol docs and holds zero principal in ListaStrategyV2.
pegMechanism: Borrowers open leveraged xBNB or sigmaClisBNBSY long positions (1.1x to 7x) in PoolManager to mint bnbUSD against WBNB or SY-clisBNB collateral, priced by dual-source BNBPriceOracle contracts that combine Chainlink BNB/USD and Binance Oracle BNB/USD with a 1% on-chain deviation clamp (2% in docs). Positions rebalance at 88% LTV (2.5% bounty) and liquidate at 95% LTV (4% bounty) through BnbUSDBasePool (Stability Pool) and ReservePool, with residual bad debt socialised via the pool debt index. PegKeeper arbitrages the Curve bnbUSD/USDT pool around a 0.998 downward threshold, and PoolManager.redeem() permits bnbUSD holders to redeem for pool collateral at a 0.5% fee (up to 20% per tick) when PoolConfiguration.isRedeemAllowed() is active during below-peg states. Both BNBPriceOracle contracts revert with expired whenever either Chainlink or Binance Oracle exceeds its 810,000-second heartbeat.

notices.title: Stale Binance Oracle reverts pool pricing calls
notices.message: Both Sigma BNBPriceOracle contracts require fresh answers from Chainlink and Binance Oracle within an 810,000-second heartbeat. On November 27, 2026, the Binance Oracle BNB/USD feed had not updated since October 14, 2026, causing getPrice(), liquidations, and collateral redemptions to revert until governance replaces the oracle or the feed resumes.
